sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on,code

sections.title: Manual deadlines
sections.sql: select code,name,due_on,topic_count,topic_blocks,snapshots from v_publications order by due_on

sections.title: Impact of a topic edit
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,manuals,used_in from v_reuse order by manuals desc,code

sections.title: Topics by review date
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,revision,review_due,standing from v_review_queue order by review_due
